text.p: The board of Lebanon's Solidere on Tuesday postponed its ordinary assembly and an extraordinary shareholders's meeting because they lacked a quorum, a company official said.

"The committees chairing both meetings declared the sessions postponed because the extraordinary one lacked the 66 percent quorum while the ordinary one lacked the 50 percent quorum," the official said.
"The board is now in session to reschedule both," he added.
Shareholders at the extraordinary session were due to vote on cancelling company shares worth about $170 million.
They were due to approve at the ordinary session a 25 cents dividend for 1996 -- 25 percent up on the 1995 dividend.
